_about: The Arena (Robin, 2026-11-02: a place of its own, open only sometimes, three difficulties with one super hard, not too easy and not to be exploited). You pay to go in. Each win adds to the pot; take it or go on; fall or flee and the pot is lost. Fights scale to the fighter, half to the class's bare numbers at that level and half to what you wear, so neither coming back strong nor gearing up makes it trivial. Each mode once per open day. Numbers mine, set with tools/sim-arena.ts.

normal.name: Normal
normal.words: A fair fight for your level.

legend.name: Legend
legend.words: For one who holds every Seal. Clear all five for a legend of this land.

_aboutLegend: The Legend mode (Robin, 2026-11-03, through Mitch, AD: a level 30 legendary set for each land, won from its Arena on its hardest mode, which opens once every Seal is won). A clear wins one piece of the land's set you do not have yet: your class's weapon first, then the off-hand if it suits you (an orb for a Magician, a shield for the rest); with both, the pot and a boss's piece as before. The same fee in every land. Numbers mine.
